title: federation-server: recipient routing and host-bound caller identity
description: Part b of multi-mailbox federation; supersedes JMAP-0c3q. crate-jmap-chat-federation-server: AuthenticatedPeer becomes { peer_domain, account_id } (the single peer-role account, fed L196/L404); remove peer_identity and with_did_verified (fed L338: binding does not use ownerUserId). FederationBackend gains mailbox_account(caller, recipient_user_id) -> Result<Option<Id>> with NO default (octet match on ownerUserId, fed L404) and verify_did_identity(caller, did) -> Result<bool> with default Ok(false). authenticate() becomes async: bind_identity(claimed, peer_domain); NeedsDidVerification -> verify_did_identity; else bare forbidden (no peer_identity compare). New route() replacing check_account: wrong accountId -> accountNotFound; unknown recipient -> bare forbidden identical to every other forbidden (7.20), checked before any placeholder ChatContact is created; owner mismatch -> serverFail. Handlers: parse -> authenticate -> route -> load mailbox; responses echo the peer account, storage uses the mailbox (deliver.rs SilentDrop/Commit, receipt, typing, retract, group_update, presence). FederationPresenceBackend keys by (mailbox, subscriberId) (fed L1049); subscribe_presence returns Result<Option<u64>>, None = refused -> forbidden (spec b00a6ee). Doc updates per lib.rs and handler docs. Tests (oracle: compliance-tests 7.16, 7.20; fed L336, L404, L1049; draft forbidden example L1248-1275): two mailboxes on one domain each get only their own deliveries and responses echo the peer account; nobody@ -> forbidden, nothing stored, no ChatContact; non-member Peer/typing error equals the nobody error; wrong accountId -> accountNotFound; alice@A.Example and carol@a.example accepted from one peer, bob@b.example forbidden for every caller-identity field; did:key forbidden by default, accepted when verify_did_identity returns true; presence subscriptions per recipient distinct; refused subscription -> forbidden; drive the draft forbidden example through handle_peer_deliver. Update ~45 JSON fixtures with recipientUserId. BREAKING.
notes: Mark decided 2026-10-31: verify_did_identity defaults to Ok(false) (refuse by default); a host-less did:key caller identity is forbidden unless the backend overrides it.
